name: Optolink-Splitter
description: Local Viessmann Optolink switch/splitter with MQTT and TCP/IP access while retaining optional Vitoconnect/ViCare connectivity.

notes.text: This helper uses a privileged LXC so the community-scripts core can automatically bind common USB serial devices such as /dev/ttyUSB0 and /dev/serial/by-id.

MQTT is disabled by default. The image installs the hardware-verified VDensHO1/20C2 Home Assistant profile at /opt/optolink/homeassistant_poll_list.py. Configure the MQTT broker in /opt/optolink/settings_ini.py to publish Home Assistant discovery.
